verdict.rationale: Inngest documents built-in capture of execution data for every run, including traces, event logs and per-step timing without instrumentation. Its CLI can find a failed run, pull its trace and identify the failing step, and a user reports the dev server makes debugging easy. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-step input/output payloads and per-step retry history in a dashboard timeline, documented dashboard search and filter across runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of the run-timeline UI.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every run has a step-by-step timeline — inputs, outputs, retries, and errors per step — in a dashboard my team can search and filter

citations.quote: Inngest captures execution data for every function run. You get metrics, traces, event logs, and per-step timing without instrumenting your code.
This guide walks you through finding a failed run, pulling its trace, and identifying which step broke.
The development server is neat and makes debugging jobs very easy.
